decision.summary: Tenant sent a Breathing Space notice and offered £100/month extra. I paused arrears contact, noted the record, informed adviser, tenant and landlord, and escalated to legal to cancel scheduled enforcement actions and decide on the plan.

answers.question: 1. What legal constraint applies and what can't you do?
answers.answer: A standard Breathing Space from 01/10/2026. We cannot pursue arrears contact with the tenant (beyond replying to what he initiates), take enforcement, serve Section 8 or any arrears notice; current rent and repairs continue. The 12/10 SMS and 14/10 Section 8 draft must not proceed.

answers.question: 2. Can you accept the proposed payment plan?
answers.answer: No. A payment plan needs landlord and human authority, and any negotiation goes through the debt adviser. It has been passed on, not accepted.

answers.question: 3. What actions and communications?
answers.answer: Note on tenant record (A1); email to adviser Ruth Okoye (A2); short acknowledgement to tenant (A3); landlord Ben informed (A4); P2 legal escalation ESC-105 (A5).
